## Setup
```{r}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("rlist")
library("cowplot")
library("SingleR")
library("RColorBrewer")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

lim <- 100
```

## Load data
```{r}
load(file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, ".rda")))
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(seurat) <- assay2
seurat$Type <- factor(seurat$Type, levels = c("WT", "KO"))
seurat <- set_percent(seurat)
```

## QC
```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_mqc(seurat, file = file.path(path_fig, "table_stats.png"))
```

### Negative / positive control genes
```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
g_neg <- c("DRD1", "ALB", "MYL1", "NPPA") %>% sort()
g_pos <- c("GAPDH", "ACTB", "TMSB4X", "B2M") %>% sort()
g_ctr <- c(g_neg, g_pos)
g_sex <- c("XIST", "DDX3Y")
list.map(
    list(g_sex, g_ctr),
    ~plot_dot(seurat, features = func_format(.), group.by = "Patient")
) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, align = "hv")
```

## Cell cycle
```{r}
seurat <- CellCycleScoring(
  seurat,
  s.features = func_format(cc.genes$s.genes), 
  g2m.features = func_format(cc.genes$g2m.genes), 
  set.ident = TRUE
)
seurat$CC.Difference <- seurat$S.Score - seurat$G2M.Score
```

## Automatic annotation
### Database processing
```{r}
if (species == "human") {
    hpca <- celldex::HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData()
} else {
    hpca <- celldex::ImmGenData()
}

hpca$label.main <- format_annot(hpca$label.main)
hpca$label.fine <- format_annot(hpca$label.fine)

bcell_subtypes <- unique(hpca$label.fine) %>%
  .[str_detect(., "FR[A-F]|CLP")] %>%
  sort() %>%
  rev()
is_bcell <- str_starts(hpca$label.fine, "B cell")
keep_cells <- (!is_bcell) | (hpca$label.fine %in% bcell_subtypes)

hpca2 <- hpca[, keep_cells]

cts <- GetAssayData(seurat, layer = 'counts')
```

### Modelling
```{r}
cell_type <- SingleR(
  test = cts,
  ref = hpca,
  labels = hpca$label.main
)

cell_subtype <- SingleR(
  test = cts,
  ref = hpca2,
  labels = hpca2$label.fine
)

annotation <- list(cell_type = cell_type, cell_subtype = cell_subtype)
save(annotation, file = file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, "_annotation.rda")))
```

### Visualization
```{r}
seurat <- format_celltype(seurat, annotation, path_fig = path_fig, lim = lim)
```

```{r}
plotScoreHeatmap(
  annotation[["cell_type"]],
  color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))(100)
)
```

```{r}
seurat <- format_celltype(seurat, annotation, type = "cell_subtype", path_fig = path_fig, lim = lim)

seurat$cell_type_formatted <- remove_parenthesis(seurat$cell_subtype)
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted <- keep_parenthesis(seurat$cell_subtype) %>% factor(levels = reorder_celltype(.))
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted2 <- seurat$cell_subtype_formatted
```

```{r}
plotDeltaDistribution(
    annotation[["cell_type"]],
    labels.use = remove_parenthesis(seurat$cell_subtype_raw),
    size = .5,
    pruned.color = "red"
)
```

```{r}
plotDeltaDistribution(
    annotation[["cell_subtype"]],
    ncol = 10,
    size = .5,
    pruned.color = "red"
)
```
